rounds.q: How many million years ago did the dinosaurs die out?
rounds.why: They first showed up about 245 million years ago, so their run lasted nearly 180 million years.
rounds.src: Natural History Museum (London), When did dinosaurs live? (read 2026)
rounds.fun: Gone 66 million years ago, after a run of nearly 180 million. What a stay!

rounds.q: How many feet long is SUE, the T. rex skeleton at Chicago's Field Museum?
rounds.why: SUE is just over 40 feet long, stood 13 feet tall at the hip, and lived to about 28.
rounds.src: Field Museum, SUE the T. rex (read 2026)
rounds.fun: 40 feet long and 13 feet tall at the hip. SUE needs a very big room!

rounds.q: About how many teeth did a T. rex have in its mouth?
rounds.why: Each saw-edged tooth could be up to 20 centimeters long, which is about 8 inches.
rounds.src: Natural History Museum (London), Dino Directory: Tyrannosaurus (read 2026)
rounds.fun: 60 teeth, each up to about 8 inches long. That is one serious smile!

rounds.q: How fast did a T. rex walk when it was just strolling, in mph?
rounds.why: A 2021 study of its swinging tail got 2.86 mph, about the same as a person's easy walk.
rounds.src: van Bijlert, van Soest and Schulp, Royal Society Open Science (2021 study)
rounds.fun: A T. rex out for a stroll did about 3 mph. You could have walked beside it!

rounds.q: What year was the word "dinosaur" invented?
rounds.why: Richard Owen made the name for just three animals, first described in 1824, 1825 and 1833.
rounds.src: Natural History Museum (London), Dinosauria: How the 'terrible lizards' got their name (read 2026)
rounds.fun: A brand new word in 1842, made for just three animals. Small start!
